name: The Park Hotel
accommodation: 32 en-suite rooms (single to family), plus 11 self-contained contractor rooms

overview: A hotel overlooking the Redcar coastline with 32 en-suite rooms ranging from singles to family rooms, many with sea views. There is a restaurant, carvery and late bar for residents, and parking is free. It sits on the seafront, close to the beach.
